subject: Pin request and interim routing plan for Magellan-2X onboard
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Maria Torres <maria@novacorp.com>
Cc: Novacorp Procurement <procurement@novacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pin request and interim routing plan for Magellan-2X onboard

Hi all —

Novacorp is ready to move to Magellan-2X for a subset of their assistant queries next week. They asked for a short-term guarantee that the variant we serve for them won’t change mid-rollout while we validate runtime behaviour. From product: they want consistency for A/B analysis and procurement needs the model name locked for the initial purchase order.

Ask: I’d like to request a provisional version pin (magellan-2x:v1.0-lock) for Novacorp’s tenant for up to 30 days while we run a fast compatibility/stability window. This would be a provisional pin that can be lifted with 48h notice after sign-off.

Requirements I need from infra/serving:
- Quick runtime compatibility check (kernels, tokenizer parity, and kv-cache behavior).
- Canary routing plan (us-west1 canary with 5% traffic, fallback to magellan-2x-compat if any telemetry anomaly).
- Telemetry contract: top-line latency P50/P95, tokenization mismatch rate, and failure/error spike triggers.

Owners: Marissa (serving ops) — runtime checks and canary config.
Priyom (product) — will own acceptance criteria and evaluation prompts.
Laura (intake/rollout) — ingress routing and rollout window coordination.

Timeline: Please respond with feasibility and estimated ETA by EOD Tuesday (2026-08-04). Novacorp is targeting a staged rollout starting 2026-08-10.

Thanks —
Karthik
Sr. PM, Model Intake & Deployment
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: intake_form_magellan-2x.pdf (pdf)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Maria Torres <maria@novacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pin request and interim routing plan for Magellan-2X onboard

Thanks Karthik — quick readout from the runtime side after a morning pass.

Short answer: feasible with conditions.

Notes:
- Tokenizer: Magellan-2X uses a slightly different BPE seed compared to Magellan-1. That produces a ~0.7% tokenization divergence on our eval suite for English. We can work around it by serving a tokenizer shim for the tenant during the provisional pin, but it requires a short-lived sidecar and extra CPU.
- Kernels: there is one kernel path (fused-attn-v2) that triggers on long-contexts (>=2048). Our current stable runtime has that kernel behind a flag. Enabling it for the canary will require a targeted kernel rollout on the dedicated pool.
- KV-cache: no API surface changes, but observed a small memory pressure increase on 16GB GPUs in our integration runs; recommend canary on 40GB or higher instance sizes.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) We run the compatibility checklist (I attached the checklist) and a short smoke test against Novacorp ingress (25k tokens, representative prompts).
2) Canary plan: us-west1 dedicated pool, 5% traffic, 72h steady-state window, auto-revert on >3x error rate or >20% increase in latency P95.
3) Temporary tokenizer shim for Novacorp only — sidecar CPU cost estimate: +8 vCPU.

ETA: I can get the checklist run and canary config finished by Tue morning (2026-08-04 10:30 PT) if product confirms acceptance criteria.

Attachments: magellan-2x-compat-checklist.xlsx

—Marissa
Principal SRE, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Maria Torres <maria@novacorp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novacorp Procurement <procurement@novacorp.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pin request and interim routing plan for Magellan-2X onboard

Thanks Karthik and Marissa — this is helpful. A few quick clarifications from Novacorp:

- Procurement needs the model identifier in the PO. If you provisionally pin to magellan-2x:v1.0-lock, we can include that exact string.
- For the tokenizer shim: please include the incremental cost estimate so we can model TCO.
- Can you confirm SLO targets we should expect for the initial 5% canary (P50, P95 token latency) and what visibility we’ll have into the telemetry? We’ll need read-only access to the canary dashboards during the 72h window.

If you can send a one-page summary for procurement items (model id, canary dates, cost delta, rollback conditions), we’ll route the PO.

—Maria Torres
Director, AI Integrations
Novacorp
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Torres <maria@novacorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pin request and interim routing plan for Magellan-2X onboard

Summary and next steps (decision record):

Decision: Provisional pin granted for Novacorp: magellan-2x:v1.0-lock. Pin duration: 30 days from 2026-08-10 with 48h lift notice. This is provisional and scoped to Novacorp tenant only.

Action items and owners:
- Marissa: complete compatibility checklist and run smoke tests by Tue 2026-08-04 10:30 PT (confirmed). Provide telemetry thresholds and dashboard link. (Attachment: magellan-2x-canary-runbook.md)
- Priyom: define acceptance criteria and evaluation prompt set by EOD 2026-08-05.
- Laura: configure routing rules for canary (us-west1, 5% traffic) and verify instance sizing (>=40GB) by 2026-08-07.
- Karthik: produce procurement one-pager for Novacorp (model id, cost delta, rollback conditions) and circulate to procurement by 2026-08-06.

SLO commitments for canary (informal for the 72h window):
- P50 token latency: <= 10ms
- P95 token latency: <= 35ms
- Error spike threshold: >3x baseline error rate triggers auto-revert
- Tokenization divergence: alert if >1.5% on eval prompts

Telemetry & access: read-only dashboard link and short-lived Grafana token will be created for Novacorp on day 1 of the canary.

If anyone expects pushback on CPU cost for the tokenizer shim, call it out in replies and we’ll add it to the procurement one-pager.

Thanks everyone — please treat this thread as the canonical intake record; I’ll file INF-8932 and attach this trail.

Karthik
Sr. PM, Model Intake & Deployment
Redwood Inference
